assumptions: The exit-code half of the issue was already satisfied on the base commit: vacuity-check already routes a zero denominator through gateOutcome and exits EXIT_ABSTAINED (3). Verified by running the built CLI against an empty directory, a file holding no tests, and a nonexistent path -- all three exited 3 before any change. The fix is therefore scoped to the disclosure half, not to the exit code, and no exit-code contract changes.

Denominator wording is `[N file(s) resolved, M test(s) scanned]`, appended to every verdict line (pass, findings, abstention) ahead of the existing skipped suffix, rather than only on abstentions -- the issue's first acceptance bullet is about the zero-FINDING run, which is a pass.

The JSON envelope gains `files` alongside the existing `checked` rather than renaming or nesting anything: the dogfood workflow and skills-verify consumers read the existing keys, so the change is additive.

`files` counts paths resolved for scanning (directory walk result, or 1 for an explicit file argument), including ones later skipped as unreadable -- resolution and successful scanning are the two numbers the issue asks to be distinguishable.

No new abstention vocabulary was coined: the issue asked for reuse of reportAbstention/reportVerified, and the existing gateOutcome/EXIT_ABSTAINED path already provides it, so nothing in ts/test/abstention-testkit.ts needed extending.
